summary: Network and custom host name setup is simpler and can be undone cleanly.

new.title: Hub preparation without extra tools
new.text: The script for the hub network owner now runs on any machine with PowerShell, needs no Azure CLI, shows a plan first and never deletes anything.

new.title: Remove a custom host name again
new.text: You can now take a custom host name off PIM Manager again; setup removes its binding and certificate and tells you which DNS record to delete.

fixes.title: Custom host name uses the right DNS zone
fixes.text: The private DNS record now lands in the existing zone your name belongs to, and an already linked network is left alone.

fixes.title: More certificate formats accepted
fixes.text: A Key Vault certificate in PEM format now works for a custom host name, and a public environment no longer waits 20 minutes for a certificate that cannot issue.
